message.content:
London’s official time zone is **Europe/London**.  
- During standard time (roughly late October – late March) it follows **GMT (UTC +0)**.  
- In the summer months (late March – late October) it switches to **BST (British Summer Time, UTC +1)**.

If you need the exact current offset or the present local time, let me know!
